description: This file defines the EvaluationRunner class responsible for managing evaluation processes, including fetching model cost metrics, running evaluations, and handling API interactions with chatflow endpoints.

classes.name: EvaluationRunner
classes.description: A class that manages evaluation workflows, including metrics collection, API calls to chatflow endpoints, and cost calculations.

methods.name: getCostMetrics
methods.description: Fetches cost metrics for a given provider and model, trying CHAT and LLM types.

methods.name: getAndDeleteMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves and removes metrics associated with a specific ID, optionally fetching cost metrics.

methods.name: addMetrics
methods.description: Adds a metric string to the metrics map under a specific ID.

methods.name: runEvaluations
methods.description: Runs evaluations on provided data, iterating over chatflow IDs and collecting results.

methods.name: evaluateChatflow
methods.description: Performs evaluation of a specific chatflow, sending requests, processing responses, and handling errors.
